text:
Dear Sir,

I am writing to inquire about hiring your Marlowe for a client event. I would like to arrange for the vehicle to be picked up on 25/05/2027 at 10.30am and returned on 27th May 2027 at 6:00 pm. We would appreciate it if you could bring the vehicle to Brackenridge Manor and collect it from there afterwards. Furthermore, we would like it to be available with a chauffeur.

Sincerely,
Milo Larkmoor
